title: Mongo: planned failover (rs.stepDown) + RTO
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster mongo`: steps down the current PRIMARY, measures the election RTO until a NEW primary appears, then confirms the cluster healed.

observe.what: original primary -> new primary; RTO timeline (failure injected / new primary observed); recovery=recovered. Live: ~2.8s.
a different member now stateStr=PRIMARY; the stepped-down node is SECONDARY

whatProves: MongoAdapter.FailoverAsync runs rs.stepDown(60) on the PRIMARY and measures a real election RTO; the RS self-heals to 1 PRIMARY + 2 SECONDARY.
